My dear [Miss Dampier](/person/1345),
I am sorry to do no more than leave the parcel but we have to be at home in time to take [Mrs Halliday](/person/616) to meet the train, so I can only deposit this at your door. I am much better thank you, and the nightingales have begun to sing in hearing from the house though not as near as they sometimes are. I enclose the 1/6 for Montrose.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
